variants.specifics: Brackenford: Three townsfolk: a worry, a pointer, a word about Halvard.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: There is a healer next to the Chapel of the Ford.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: We will hold the ford, but you must see Halvard in the Moot Hall. Thanks for your help, brave Adventurer!

variants.specifics: Skarn Delve: Three townsfolk: a tip about Mobb and the Lift Key, a tease, and a word about the Trolls

rumour1.speaker: Tarn
rumour1.text: You can find Mobb the Tallyman in the Counting House. He has the Lift Key.

rumour2.speaker: Ysolt
rumour2.text: Duck, stranger, duck! Hee, hee, hee...!

rumour3.speaker: Garn
rumour3.text: We have held the Counting House! Now we must drive the Trolls out of all of Skarn Delve!

variants.specifics: Gorrow: Three townsfolk of Gorrow: one pestered by leeches, one brushing the player off, one with something on his leg

rumour1.speaker: Yarrin
rumour1.text: Help! The leeches are in my bed!

rumour3.speaker: Tuk
rumour3.text: Blaaargh! Get this thing off my leg!

variants.specifics: Karth Vael: Three townsfolk of Karth Vael: Nessa asks about the pass, Crull gossips about the Troll King, Tam brushes the player off.

rumour1.speaker: Nessa
rumour1.text: Hello again. Has the Troll King been stopped, yet?

rumour2.speaker: Crull
rumour2.text: I hear that the Troll King has finally lost his patience. He's massing an army below Mount Dreg! Everyone must watch out for Troll scouts!

rumour3.speaker: Tam
rumour3.text: I've been told to keep away from newcomers.

variants.specifics: Orlmere: Three townsfolk: a warning, gossip about the pirates, a taunt from a drunk.

rumour2.speaker: Sedda
rumour2.text: The river-rats of Sedge Landing are a crooked and shameless band of smugglers! The worst is their boss, Joh Skarn!

rumour3.speaker: Crodd
rumour3.text: Can't swim? Not so clever, eh?

variants.specifics: Zorreth: Three townsfolk: Fenn on the Observatory, Tessik on Pellam's lost wits, Hendry brushing the player off.

rumour1.speaker: Fenn
rumour1.text: Maldrek must have found some way past our wards. At noon the Observatory was quiet, by dusk it was swarming with Gargoyles and Imps! They want the Orrery.

rumour2.speaker: Tessik
rumour2.text: I'm afraid Pellam finally lost his wits. They've given me his study since he's taken to roaming the cloisters honking like a goose and chasing pigeons.

rumour3.speaker: Hendry
rumour3.text: Shouldn't you be out chasing Gargoyles?

variants.specifics: Kell Varn: three townsfolk of Kell Varn: Ogres at the pass, the Warden, a spy

rumour1.speaker: Hobb
rumour1.text: Kell Varn will never fall to the Ogres. Stand firm for the honor of Warden Odrin!

rumour2.speaker: Vessa
rumour2.text: No, we dare not sleep while the Ogres hold the pass!

rumour3.speaker: Ketra
rumour3.text: A spy from the Hold just ran past me! Be fast! He's heading for the gate!

variants.specifics: Ashkar: Three townsfolk: Fenn on a slug at Maldrek's door, Yara teasing, Odo on a missing ore cart.

rumour1.speaker: Fenn
rumour1.text: Ew! I watched that huge lava slug ooze right under Maldrek's door!

rumour2.speaker: Yara
rumour2.text: You're pretty puny for a hammer-boy. Hah, hah, hah...!

rumour3.speaker: Odo
rumour3.text: Did you see where the ore cart went? It couldn't have just rolled away!

variants.specifics: Tolmar Cross: Lorna flirts, Wick the drunk taunts, Dray wants the Troll chief dead.

rumour1.speaker: Lorna
rumour1.text: Hello stranger! Look me up when you're done with the Trolls.

rumour2.speaker: Wick
rumour2.text: Watcha gonna do? Throw me out?

rumour3.speaker: Dray
rumour3.text: Get that Troll chief and tear his tusks out!

variants.specifics: Tosk: Three townsfolk of Tosk: praise after the boar hunt, a word on the Ogre chief's raids, a farmer's shout.

rumour1.speaker: Dobb
rumour1.text: They say you're the one who chased those pesky boars off our fields! Thank you, kind sir!

rumour2.speaker: Lorra
rumour2.text: That brute Brakk has left the east fields in ruins. Find his scouts before they reach the mill.

rumour3.speaker: Tamsin
rumour3.text: Hey! Get out of my barn!
